fact: The DGI says Simpl modules (TVA, IS, IR) let taxpayers file returns online (teledeclarations).
The DGI says Simpl lets taxpayers pay taxes online (telepaiements), with payment methods including direct debit and multichannel.
The Direction Generale des Impots says firms file corporate tax, income tax and VAT returns online through its SIMPL-IS, SIMPL-IR and SIMPL-TVA teleservices, with 15,200 taxpayers already enrolled.
The Direction Generale des Impots says tax payments (telepaiements) for corporate tax, income tax and VAT are made through the SIMPL teleservices.

The Direction Generale des Impots says electronic filing and payment of corporate tax, income tax and VAT become mandatory for all firms from 1 January 2017, except those on the flat-rate income tax regime.

Hespress reports that the Direction generale des impots launched in May 2026 the electronic platform "Taxation on Digital Services" for foreign providers of remote services, under decree 2.25.862 which sets how they register, declare their Moroccan turnover and pay VAT.

Decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025 requires non-resident suppliers of remote digital services to register on the tax administration's electronic platform, file VAT returns electronically each quarter and pay electronically, entering into force six months after publication.
